neighbours.label: The token ' App' / 'App' when it begins the fruit word 'Apples' (App|les): the output writes 'les' and suppresses ' Apple', ' iPhone', ' iOS'. 'App' as software (App Store) or starting other words (Appliances, Approval) is quiet.
fire: The market stall was nearly empty by noon. Apples and a few bruised peaches were all that remained.
Our school lunches changed this year. Apples replaced the biscuits on every tray.
Autumn is the busiest season at the farm. Apples are pressed into cider from September onwards.
The dentist gave the children a short list of snacks. Apples, carrots and cheese were at the top.
Grandfather planted the orchard in 1950. Apples from those trees still win prizes at the fair.
The recipe calls for something tart. Apples work better than pears in this pie.
Frost came late that spring. Apples were scarce and expensive all winter.
The horses crowded along the fence at feeding time. Apples were their favourite treat.
quiet: The market stall was nearly empty by noon. Peaches and a few bruised plums were all that remained.
Our school phones changed this year. Apps replaced the paper forms in every class.
Autumn is the busiest season at the store. Appliances are discounted from September onwards.
The teacher gave the children a short list of downloads. App Store links were at the top.
Grandfather planted the orchard in 1950. Cherries from those trees still win prizes at the fair.
The grant calls for something formal. Approval takes longer than people expect in this office.
Frost came late that spring. Oranges were scarce and expensive all winter.
The crowd rose along the fence at the final whistle. Applause was their only reward.

notes: Card: ' App' x10, 'App' x5 before 'les' in fruit lists and in 'applescript'/'apples' code. Probe: ' Apples' in fruit context 0.93 and 0.87; 'App Store' 0.19, 'Pears' 0.10, ' app' 0.02, 'Approval/Appliances' 0.00.
